Option.value:
CASE
-- 1) SFC ve değer 0 ise GND WHEN "ais_UPPER_LIMIT_REFERENCE" = 'SFC' AND to_int("ais_UPPER_LIMIT") = 0 THEN 'GND'
-- 2) MSL ve değer 0 ise MSL WHEN "ais_UPPER_LIMIT_REFERENCE" = 'MSL' AND to_int("ais_UPPER_LIMIT") = 0 THEN 'MSL'
-- 3) UNL kontrolü WHEN "ais_UPPER_LIMIT_REFERENCE" IN ('STD','MSL') AND to_int("ais_UPPER_LIMIT") IN (999,99999) THEN 'UNL'
-- 4) STD ise FL formatı WHEN "ais_UPPER_LIMIT_REFERENCE" = 'STD' THEN 'FL ' || lpad("ais_UPPER_LIMIT",3,'0')
-- 5) MSL ise FT AMSL WHEN "ais_UPPER_LIMIT_REFERENCE" = 'MSL' THEN "ais_UPPER_LIMIT" || ' FT AMSL'
-- 6) SFC ise FT AGL formatı WHEN "ais_UPPER_LIMIT_REFERENCE" = 'SFC' THEN "ais_UPPER_LIMIT" || ' FT AGL'
ELSE "ais_UPPER_LIMIT"
END

NAME : ([^<]*)')), with_variable('u_lim', trim(regexp_substr("pic", 'UPPER LIMIT : ([^<]*)')), with_variable('u_ref', trim(regexp_substr("pic", 'UPPER LIMIT REF. : ([^<]*)')), with_variable('l_lim', trim(regexp_substr("pic", 'LOWER LIMIT : ([^<]*)')), with_variable('l_ref', trim(regexp_substr("pic", 'LOWER LIMIT REF. : ([^<]*)')), @isim1 || ' ' || @isim2 || ' ' || CASE WHEN @l_ref = 'SFC' AND to_int(@l_lim) = 0 THEN 'GND' WHEN @l_ref = 'MSL' AND to_int(@l_lim) = 0 THEN 'MSL' WHEN @l_ref IN ('STD','MSL') AND to_int(@l_lim) IN (999,99999) THEN 'UNL' WHEN @l_ref = 'STD' THEN 'FL ' || lpad(@l_lim,3,'0') WHEN @l_ref = 'MSL' THEN @l_lim || ' FT AMSL' WHEN @l_ref = 'SFC' THEN @l_lim || ' FT AGL' ELSE @l_lim END || ' - ' || CASE WHEN @u_ref = 'SFC' AND to_int(@u_lim) = 0 THEN 'GND' WHEN @u_ref = 'MSL' AND to_int(@u_lim) = 0 THEN 'MSL' WHEN @u_ref IN ('STD','MSL') AND to_int(@u_lim) IN (999,99999) THEN 'UNL' WHEN @u_ref = 'STD' THEN 'FL ' || lpad(@u_lim,3,'0') WHEN @u_ref = 'MSL' THEN @u_lim || ' FT AMSL' WHEN @u_ref = 'SFC' THEN @u_lim || ' FT AGL' ELSE @u_lim END || CASE WHEN trim(coalesce("classification",'')) <> '' THEN ' ' || trim("classification") ELSE '' END ))))))
